title: Store.findTool
description: The tools' part of the SQLite `Store`: `insertTool`, `findTool`, `listTools` and `setToolCondition`; each of its commands runs in `transaction()`.

title: Store.findLoan
description: The loans' part of the SQLite `Store`: `insertLoan`, `findLoan`, `activeLoansForMember`, `activeLoanForTool` and `markReturned`, which touches only an active loan; `transaction()` so a check and its write happen together.
